updateTime.description: Date and time when this consolidated anomaly correlation document was last updated by the consolidation engine

key.description: Key uniquely identifying the anomaly correlation file

title.description: Title of the anomaly correlation file, parsed to extract the associated GSANOM issue

status.description: Current status of the anomaly correlation file

created.description: Creation date of the anomaly correlation file

updated.description: Last update date of the anomaly correlation file

issue.description: Linked issue identifiers associated with the anomaly, searched for the related GSANOM issue

station_type.description: Type of the ground station impacted by the anomaly, used to build acquisition pass keys

station.description: Ground station(s) impacted by the anomaly, used to build acquisition pass keys

ticket_id.description: Identifier of the associated GSANOM issue extracted from the title or the linked issues

impacted_passes.description: Impacted acquisition passes declared in the anomaly, used to derive acquisition pass keys

impacted_observations.description: Impacted observations declared in the anomaly, used to derive corrected datatake identifiers

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit(s) impacted by the anomaly

products.description: Normalized names of products impacted by the anomaly
